protein: TEM-19 β-lactamase (class A serine beta-lactamase; TEM-1 plus G236S (Ambler 238))
readout: Fitness under band-pass ampicillin selection, as deposited; higher is more active
assay_method: PFunkel comprehensive codon mutagenesis of each TEM allele, assayed in Escherichia coli with the Sohka band-pass selection system (10.1073/pnas.0901246106): cells are plated on tetracycline plus a variable antibiotic concentration and grow only when beta-lactamase activity falls inside a window, since too little activity fails the antibiotic challenge while too much prevents the cell-wall damage that induces TetC. Per-variant scores were taken from the authors' MaveDB deposit urn:mavedb:00000085.
remark: The wild type here is TEM19, which is TEM-1 plus G236S (Ambler 238); positions are sequential over the 286-residue preprotein, not the Ambler numbering the beta-lactamase literature uses, where Ambler is sequential + 2 up to 236, + 3 for 237-249 and + 4 for 250-286. Each allele in this deposit is its own wild type, so the four score sets are four datasets rather than one. 872 rows carry no score. There is no wild-type row in the deposit, so wt_readout is empty and the zero point of normalized-score is the dataset mean. MaveDB records no publication for this deposit, and the 2025 branch's parked tracker attributed it to 10.1073/pnas.0901246106, which is the band-pass method paper rather than the source of these measurements; the source is this row's DOI, whose abstract describes the TEM-1, TEM-17, TEM-19 and TEM-15 allele series.
